title: Acquire partial-capo fixtures with verified string ordering
scope: Acquire controlled native partial-capo fixtures and establish string order, fret units and note pitches. Acquisition, retaining library implementation and final acceptance review are complete.
acceptance: Provide an authorized native-saved control and asymmetric partial-capo fixture from the same minimal six-string score. Use partial fret 3 on named strings 1 and 4. Give each string one identifiable open note. Record application version, hashes, UI values and experimental seed provenance. State the actual authoring version within the shared GP7/GP8 GPIF family.

Provide a native combined-capo variant with whole capo 2 and partial absolute fret 5. Record exact wire offsets and native MIDI pitches. Record the native response to a partial fret less than the whole capo. If the application refuses that value, provide its refusal and a zero-offset control instead of an invented valid fixture.

Record exact GPIF PartialCapoFret and PartialCapoStringFlags fields. Use controlled single-string siblings to establish flag order independently from tuning reversal. Retain the named native UI labels and corresponding MIDI pitches.

Run public Go ParseWithOptions and pinned AlphaTab on every valid fixture. Record source fields, diagnostic paths and parser settings. Keep native Guitar Pro results separate because the pinned reference does not retain partial capo.

Deliver the fixtures and machine-readable receipts in the corpus and database. Define the mapping and public edit contract only after native facts establish them. Keep acquisition evidence separate from implementation tests and support ratings. Review the exact final commit before closure.
exclusions: No per-string API or pitch conversion before fixture facts exist.
No tuning modification as a proxy; no AlphaTab upgrade; no claim that absence in AlphaTab validates values.

reproduction.instructions: Use the seven testdata/gp8/partial-capo-*.gp native fixtures. Run conformance/capabilities/partial_capo_probe.go and partial_capo_probe.mjs on those files. Compare the results with evidence/partial-capo-native.json. Run the test_partial_capo_native.py tests for exact wire fields, native MIDI events and artifact hashes. The receipt distinguishes controlled XML seeds from native edits and saves.

external_inputs.requirement: Owned native GP8 control, asymmetric and single-string variants, combined whole/partial capo, zero-offset boundary and selected fretted-note control.
external_inputs.acquisition: Controlled XML seeds followed by native Guitar Pro Tuning edits, Keep the Fingering and Save As. Exact seed provenance is retained. No native string-selection-menu action is claimed.

external_inputs.requirement: Native Tuning labels, exact whole/partial values and per-string MIDI pitches, bound to fixture hashes. Include the refused below-whole value and accepted zero-offset boundary.
external_inputs.acquisition: Guitar Pro 8.1.5 build 31 reopened and saved the controlled files and exported MIDI. Named Tuning labels and note events establish string order independently.

evidence.detail: needs-evidence: Partial-capo properties exist, but nonzero fixture semantics, string-flag order and a retaining oracle are missing.

The next required artifact is a Guitar Pro fixture with a nonzero partial capo fret and asymmetric string flags, plus a consumer that retains those values. Use it to establish flag/string order, pitch effects and interaction with whole-staff capo. Pinned AlphaTab currently discards the properties, so its default output cannot validate the semantics. Once those facts are known, create a bounded mapping/API contract linked to #43. Until then keep the unsupported status explicit; do not infer the flags from tuning or collapse them into the whole-staff capo.
Known GPIF spellings emit default fret 0 and all-zero string flags.
The complete pinned staff-property switch handles Tuning, chord collections and CapoFret; it has no PartialCapo reader or retained model mapping.

Fresh ZIP GPIF scan at reviewed commit: 376 containers parsed; 849 PartialCapoFret occurrences all 0; 849 PartialCapoStringFlags occurrences all zero; no non-default partial-capo source. 849 FretCount occurrences all 24.

Verified 2026-09-11. Capo section: partial applies selected strings; whole and partial may coexist; fret values are absolute; a partial capo below the whole capo is ineffective. These facts need not be re-investigated.
Website explicitly lists partial capo unsupported; pinned source remains the behavior authority.

Acquire the stated fixture/consumer package once. The next implementation task can then define the actual string mapping and public edit authority. Until it exists, keep this missing/target-limited and explicitly blocked on the two named inputs.
Exact failed native authoring attempt and saved zero-value candidate facts; both external inputs remain missing.
Independent agent acceptance review for issue 115; preserved current criteria, exact source commits, commands and scoped residual failures.

Guitar Pro 8.1.5 build 31 is accessible. Keyboard navigation sets partial fret 3, but the string selector remains No strings capoed. The attempt was cancelled; the required asymmetric-string fixture and retaining pitch receipt remain missing.

Seven native cases, exact hashes, wire fields, occurrence paths, MIDI events and UI records. Relative partial offsets affect only selected open-string notes. The below-whole attempt is a finite native refusal, not a missing external input.
Four executable checks cover artifact integrity, exact native wire/MIDI values, named UI/boundary facts and old public/pinned limitations.
Final current-commit acceptance review, matching independent production hashes and full gate log.

resolution: Native Guitar Pro 8.1.5 build 31 validates seven source fixtures and six library exports. Public Staff.PartialCapo retains a nonnegative offset relative to the whole capo and high-first string flags. Only selected open notes receive the offset. Parser inheritance, explicit clearing, direct edits, grace notes, pitch bounds and compatibility tuning validation are covered. Pinned AlphaTab loss is a separate reference defect. All five current acceptance criteria and dependency #43 pass at bbe8204a4e0334ca055deed6726c2879d119365a. Historical receipts retain their original context.
